motto: 愿以微志既长策，岂因独怀废华章

tasks.content: 线上 100 词／天；线下 20 词／天

tasks.req: 配合语法书与课内进度
中译英写整句；英译中写结构与含义
七选五、完形、阅读 A/B、阅读 C/D
按当周实际，记不认识的

grammar.point: 句子成分与五种基本句型
grammar.detail: 主谓、主系表、主谓宾、主谓双宾、主谓宾补。判断句子成分，先找谓语动词，再定主语与宾语。
grammar.watch: 主谓宾补与双宾易混；形式主语 it 不算真正主语；被动语态改写在翻译题里出现频繁。

sentences.text: 老师让我们把这段话改写成被动语态。
sentences.answer: The teacher had us rewrite this paragraph in the passive voice.
sentences.shint: have sb do sth（使役动词 + 宾语 + 补语）

sentences.text: 学校给我们提供了一个可以安静读书的地方。
sentences.answer: The school provides us with a quiet place to read.
sentences.shint: provide sb with sth（双宾语的介词改写）

sentences.text: 现代城市生活让人很难保持规律作息。
sentences.answer: Modern city life makes it hard for people to keep a regular schedule.
sentences.shint: make it + adj. + for sb to do（it 作形式宾语）

sentences.text: What surprised the researchers was not the number of species they had found but how quickly the forest recovered after the fire.
sentences.answer: 研究人员感到意外的不是他们发现的物种数量，而是火灾之后森林恢复得有多快。
sentences.struct: What 引导主语从句；not … but … 并列两个表语；how 引导表语从句
sentences.shint: What 引导主语从句；not … but … 并列两个表语

sentences.text: It was not until the library closed that the students realised they had been reading for six hours.
sentences.answer: 直到图书馆闭馆，学生们才意识到自己已经读了六个小时。
sentences.struct: It was not until … that … 强调时间状语；had been reading 过去完成进行
sentences.shint: It was not until … that …（强调时间状语）

sentences.text: Having been warned about the heavy traffic, we left an hour earlier than planned.
sentences.answer: 由于事先被提醒过交通拥堵，我们比原计划早出发了一小时。
sentences.struct: Having been warned 完成式被动分词作原因状语；earlier than planned 比较
sentences.shint: Having been done 作原因状语，逻辑主语与主句一致

days.grammarText: 句子成分与五种基本句型

grammar.detail: 陈述、疑问、祈使、感叹四类；反意疑问句与强调疑问句的构成。
grammar.watch: 反意疑问句的助动词要与前句一致；感叹句 what 修饰名词、how 修饰形容词或副词。

sentences.text: 你今天真的打算把整本白本翻完吗？
sentences.answer: Do you really plan to go through the whole book today?
sentences.shint: Do you really plan to do …?

sentences.text: 别指望临时抱佛脚能骗过这种题。
sentences.answer: Don't expect to fool this kind of question by cramming at the last minute.
sentences.shint: Don't expect to do sth by doing sth

sentences.text: 要是早点明白这个道理该多好！
sentences.answer: How I wish I had understood this earlier!
sentences.shint: How I wish + 主语 + had done（对过去的虚拟）

sentences.text: You didn't think the exam would be that easy, did you?
sentences.hint: that easy 口语中表示“那么”
sentences.answer: 你并不觉得这次考试有那么容易，是吧？
sentences.struct: 主句否定 + 反意部分用肯定 did you
sentences.shint: 否定主句 + 肯定反意部分

sentences.text: Why is it that some students can remember a word after seeing it once while others forget it within a day?
sentences.answer: 为什么有的学生看一眼就能记住一个单词，而另一些人一天之内就忘了？
sentences.struct: Why is it that … 强调疑问；while 引导对比从句
sentences.shint: Why is it that …?（强调疑问句型）

sentences.text: Let it be a lesson, and never leave your revision until the night before again.
sentences.answer: 把它当成一个教训，以后不要再把复习拖到考试前一晚。
sentences.struct: 祈使句 + and + 祈使句；leave … until … 结构
sentences.shint: 祈使句 + and + 祈使句

grammar.detail: 语法一致、意义一致、就近一致。重点看 every、either…or、neither…nor、the number of。
grammar.watch: the number of 谓语用单数，a number of 用复数；neither…nor 遵循就近原则。

sentences.text: 我们班每个学生都有一本自己的错题本。
sentences.answer: Every student in our class keeps a notebook of their own mistakes.
sentences.shint: every + 单数名词作主语，谓语用单数；their 回指

sentences.text: 要么你，要么你的同桌，得为这次失误负责。
sentences.answer: Either you or your deskmate has to answer for this mistake.
sentences.shint: either A or B：谓语与最近的主语一致

sentences.text: 物理和化学都是需要动手做实验的学科。
sentences.answer: Physics and chemistry are both subjects that require hands-on experiments.
sentences.shint: A and B 作主语，谓语用复数

sentences.text: Neither the teacher nor the students were prepared for how quickly the discussion turned into an argument.
sentences.answer: 老师和学生都没料到讨论会这么快变成争吵。
sentences.struct: neither … nor … 就近一致，谓语用 were；how 引导宾语从句
sentences.shint: neither … nor … 就近一致；how 引导宾语从句

sentences.text: The number of students who choose to study abroad has risen sharply over the past decade.
sentences.answer: 过去十年里，选择出国留学的学生人数急剧上升。
sentences.struct: the number of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用单数 has；who 引导定语从句
sentences.shint: the number of + 复数名词，谓语用单数

sentences.text: What matters most is not how much you read but how much you actually remember.
sentences.answer: 最要紧的不是你读了多少，而是你真正记住了多少。
sentences.struct: What 引导主语从句；not … but … 并列表语从句
sentences.shint: What 引导主语从句；not … but … 并列表语从句

grammar.detail: 可数与不可数、单复数、a/an/the 的基本用法与固定搭配。
grammar.watch: 抽象名词具体化时可加冠词；the + 形容词表示一类人；固定搭配里的冠词不能省。

sentences.text: 他提出的那个想法最终变成了学校的一项新规定。
sentences.answer: The idea that he put forward eventually became a new rule of the school.
sentences.shint: the idea that …（that 引导同位语从句）

sentences.text: 在这么短的准备时间里通过考试，对他来说是个不小的挑战。
sentences.answer: Passing the exam in such a short time was quite a challenge for him.
sentences.shint: such a + adj. + n.；不定冠词表“一种”

sentences.text: 我们大多数人都低估了睡眠对记忆的重要性。
sentences.answer: Most of us underestimate the importance of sleep to memory.
sentences.shint: Most of us 作主语，谓语用复数

sentences.text: As a rule, the more carefully you plan your revision, the less anxious you feel before an exam.
sentences.answer: 通常来说，复习计划做得越细，考前就越不焦虑。
sentences.struct: the + 比较级 …, the + 比较级 …；as a rule 作状语
sentences.shint: the + 比较级 …, the + 比较级 …

sentences.text: It is said that a single cup of coffee can improve attention for about an hour, though the effect varies from person to person.
sentences.answer: 据说一杯咖啡能让注意力提高大约一小时，不过效果因人而异。
sentences.struct: It is said that … 形式主语；though 引导让步状语从句
sentences.shint: It is said that …（形式主语）；though 引导让步状语从句

sentences.text: What we call “talent” is often nothing more than a habit that has been repeated for years.
sentences.answer: 我们所谓的“天赋”，往往不过是一个重复了多年的习惯。
sentences.struct: What 引导主语从句；nothing more than 表语；that 引导定语从句
sentences.shint: What we call … is nothing more than …

grammar.detail: 人称、物主、反身、指示、不定代词；基数词与序数词、分数与百分数。
grammar.watch: one in three 谓语用单数；those who 指一类人；不定代词作主语时的单复数要看清。

sentences.text: 我把笔记借给了几个同学，他们又转借给了别人。
sentences.answer: I lent my notes to a few classmates, who passed them on to others.
sentences.shint: …, who …（非限制性定语从句）

sentences.text: 这两本参考书都不太适合初学者，你自己看着办吧。
sentences.answer: Neither of these two reference books is really suitable for beginners, so it's up to you.
sentences.shint: Neither of + 复数名词，谓语用单数

sentences.text: 每三个人里就有一个人承认自己曾在考试前熬夜。
sentences.answer: One in three people admits to having stayed up late before an exam.
sentences.shint: One in three + 单数名词，谓语用单数

sentences.text: Some of what he said was useful, but much of it had little to do with our actual problem.
sentences.hint: have to do with 与…有关
sentences.answer: 他说的有些话有用，但大部分与我们真正的问题没什么关系。
sentences.struct: Some of / much of + what 从句；but 并列分句
sentences.shint: Some of / much of + what 从句

sentences.text: Those who finish first are not necessarily those who understand best.
sentences.answer: 最先做完的人未必是理解得最好的人。
sentences.struct: Those who … 两个定语从句；not necessarily 部分否定
sentences.shint: Those who … are not necessarily those who …

sentences.text: It takes one person to start a rumour and a hundred to spread it, yet almost no one bothers to check it.
sentences.answer: 造谣只需一个人，传谣却要一百个人，然而几乎没人愿意去核实。
sentences.struct: It takes … to do …；yet 转折连词
sentences.shint: It takes … to do …；yet 表转折

grammar.detail: 比较级、最高级、倍数表达、as…as 与原级比较；修饰比较级的程度词。
grammar.watch: much / far / no / even 可修饰比较级；not so much A as B 意为“与其说 A 不如说 B”。

sentences.text: 这次考试比上次难得多，但我的发挥反而更稳定。
sentences.answer: This exam was much harder than the last one, yet I performed more steadily.
sentences.shint: much + 比较级；yet 表转折

sentences.text: 他复习得越仔细，考试时就越不容易慌。
sentences.answer: The more carefully he revises, the less likely he is to panic in the exam.
sentences.shint: the more … the less likely …

sentences.text: 与其说这是一次失败，不如说是一次提醒。
sentences.answer: It is not so much a failure as a reminder.
sentences.shint: not so much A as B

sentences.text: Her handwriting is no better than mine, but she organises her answers far more clearly.
sentences.answer: 她的字并不比我的好，但她把答案组织得清楚得多。
sentences.struct: no better than 表示“和…一样不好”；far more clearly 修饰比较级
sentences.shint: no better than（“和…一样不好”）；far more clearly

sentences.text: The harder the problem looks, the more important it is to read it twice before writing anything down.
sentences.answer: 题目看起来越难，动笔前读两遍就越重要。
sentences.struct: the + 比较级 …, the more + 形容词 …；it 为形式主语
sentences.shint: the more … the less likely …

sentences.text: Few things are as misleading as a familiar question that has been slightly changed.
sentences.answer: 很少有东西比一道稍作改动的熟题更容易误导人。
sentences.struct: Few … as … as … 否定比较；that 引导定语从句
sentences.shint: Few … as … as …；that 引导定语从句

grammar.detail: 把周一到周六出错的句子重写一遍，重点看当时漏掉的成分与搭配。
grammar.watch: 只重做错过的，不重抄全对；错因写在本页边缘。

sentences.text: 现代城市生活让人很难保持规律作息。
sentences.answer: Modern city life makes it hard for people to keep a regular schedule.
sentences.shint: make it + adj. + for sb to do（it 作形式宾语）

sentences.text: 你今天真的打算把整本白本翻完吗？
sentences.answer: Do you really plan to go through the whole book today?
sentences.shint: Do you really plan to do …?

sentences.text: 要么你，要么你的同桌，得为这次失误负责。
sentences.answer: Either you or your deskmate has to answer for this mistake.
sentences.shint: either A or B：谓语与最近的主语一致

sentences.text: It is said that a single cup of coffee can improve attention for about an hour, though the effect varies from person to person.
sentences.answer: 据说一杯咖啡能让注意力提高大约一小时，不过效果因人而异。
sentences.struct: It is said that … 形式主语；though 引导让步状语从句
sentences.shint: It is said that …（形式主语）；though 引导让步状语从句

sentences.text: 每三个人里就有一个人承认自己曾在考试前熬夜。
sentences.answer: One in three people admits to having stayed up late before an exam.
sentences.shint: One in three + 单数名词，谓语用单数

sentences.text: 他复习得越仔细，考试时就越不容易慌。
sentences.answer: The more carefully he revises, the less likely he is to panic in the exam.
sentences.shint: the more … the less likely …

days.slot: 复盘 + 阅读④ 阅读 C/D

sampleWriting.prompt: 假定你是李华，你的英国朋友 Chris 明年将来中国读大学，正在自学中文写作。他来信说自己写出来的东西“像小学生的作文”，请你回信：指出他目前最需要解决的问题，给出两条可以马上做的练习方法，并提议下个月互相批改一次作文。
emph: 两条可以马上做的练习方法
gloss: 像小学生的作文 read like a primary-school composition
互评 comment on each other's writing

sentences.text: I'm glad to hear that you're coming to China next year.
It is not that you lack ideas, but that you have not yet found a way to put them into written Chinese.
What makes Chinese writing hard is the gap between what you can read and what you can produce.
Were I in your position, I would write three sentences a day rather than one long essay a week.
It also helps if you keep a journal in Chinese and ask a native speaker to mark it.
Only when you revise your own writing will you see where the real problems are.
I would appreciate it if you could send me a short passage next month.
I'm looking forward to reading your first piece.

words.note: revise one's draft 修改初稿
an awkward sentence 别扭的句子
fluent in Chinese 中文流利

struct: I'm glad to hear that …；用现在完成时说明“一直在自学”。
两条做法各配一个结构：It also helps if + 从句（形式主语）；Only when … 倒装强调条件。
I'd appreciate it if …（委婉请求）；look forward to 后接动名词。
